$schema_note: Machine-readable availability/capability matrix for the Banzami Developers Sandbox documentation. Single conservative source checked by tests and mirrored by the PT/EN docs credential matrices. States: available_controlled_sandbox | served_pending_capability | pending_e2e | simulated | not_public | not_available | not_approved. This file describes the Public Sandbox. Financial Live is not ready: it requires institutional approval and is fail-closed; this file makes no Live or external-provider availability claim.

console_auth_workspaces_projects_members.note: Sign-in (email + OTP), workspaces, projects, members/roles/invites, test keys (reveal-once, rotate, revoke).

console_visual_pages.note: Every Console page reads the project's own real data through developer-api. The dashboard was wired to the project's API request log and webhook events; no page renders illustrative constants, and none carries an illustrative-data notice because none needs one (apps/website/app/developers/illustrative-data.test.ts asserts the list is empty).

developer_api_key.note: bz_test_ keys, direct Bearer; bz_live_ rejected fail-closed; no Production key issuance.

payment_sessions.note: Requires payment_sessions scope + ACTIVE project binding (or a merchant credential).

payment_links.note: Requires payment_links scope + ACTIVE project binding (or a merchant credential).

webhook_configuration.note: POST/GET /v1/webhooks/* with the webhooks:write and webhooks:read scopes. The signing secret is returned exactly once, on creation; another project’s endpoint answers 404.

webhook_outbound_delivery.note: Signed delivery verified on the deployed Sandbox against a public HTTPS receiver: signature confirmed independently over the raw bytes, tamper rejection, retry on 5xx and failure isolation. Sandbox only — no Production delivery claim.

refunds.note: POST /v1/refunds with the refunds:write scope. The refund debits the account that received the payment; a read-only key is refused (403) and another project’s payment answers 404.

transfers.note: POST /v1/wallet-account-transfers with the transfers:write scope. Moves value between two accounts of the caller’s own bound owner; an account outside that owner answers 404 as either endpoint.

wallet_accounts.note: POST /v1/wallet-accounts (wallet_accounts:create) and GET /v1/wallet-accounts, /{id} (wallet_accounts:read): segregated accounts inside the bound owner's wallet. PRIMARY is not creatable; another owner's account answers 404. Served on the deployed Sandbox; served and exercised on the deployed Sandbox; no released assurance capability records it on its own yet, so it carries no released badge.

application_settlements.note: POST /v1/application-settlements with the application_settlements:write scope settles a segregated account's whole available balance to a beneficiary @banza at the price Banzami assigned (the request carries no amount or rate). GET /v1/application-settlements/{id} is merchant-credential only — a project key receives 401. Served on the deployed Sandbox; served and exercised on the deployed Sandbox; no released assurance capability records it on its own yet, so it carries no released badge.

sandbox_self_service_financial_setup.note: POST /projects/{id}/financial-setup with a use case (STANDARD | APPLICATION): Core provisions a SANDBOX_SYNTHETIC Business, never verified, classified and priced by policy. No review, no operator (ADR-060).

sandbox_test_payers.note: /v1/sandbox/test-payers with sandbox:read / sandbox:write: Project-owned test payers, fictitious funding within quotas, payments by link or QR through the real payment path, explicit rail simulations.

sandbox_scenarios.note: GET /v1/sandbox/scenarios: the deterministic scenario catalogue, held to the testing guide by check-docs-dx.

realtime_payment_status.note: GET /v1/realtime/payment-sessions/{id} with a session’s bzst_ token in the Authorization header: snapshot, status events, heartbeat, terminal close. Not proof of payment.

webhook_test_event.note: POST /v1/webhooks/endpoints/{id}/test: a signed, synthetic webhook.test delivery that moves nothing and can be replayed.

api_explorer.note: Console API Explorer: published operations run server-side with a 60-second single-scope key; no key in the browser; logged with source API_EXPLORER.

sandbox_reset.note: Console reset (typed RESET, 5 a day): retires test payers and the Project’s own synthetic Business’s live test data; nothing is deleted.

production_live_rails.note: Financial Live is NOT READY and fail-closed: it requires institutional approval. No real money. No Live key issuance; bz_live_ keys are refused.

pay_checkout_live_rails.note: Live rails on the public pay/checkout surface are not available and not approved. pay.banzami.com is deployed and serves the Sandbox payer page only (virtual money).

external_provider_rails.note: No external provider is activated; activation is a separate governance decision.
